description: Stack pointer as the C runtime leaves it before main(), and RAMEND.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: ATmega328P datasheet: the stack pointer starts at RAMEND (0x08FF) after reset; avr-libc init2 sets it
